dispatch_jobs.reason: U2 tripped on HI_JACKET_TEMP at ~4:38 PM (indicated 200.6F). Jacket temp ramped steadily 161->200F over ~18 min at constant 88% load while U1/U3 stayed at 162F; discharge temp and lube oil on U2 stayed normal. After trip indicated temp fell unusually fast (200->182F in 2 min). Cannot tell remotely if this is a real cooling failure (fan/cooler, coolant loss, thermostat, freeze-up at 15F ambient) or a failing jacket temp transmitter. Need field verification before restart; gas control needs all units through 9 PM peak.
